content:
After the Liquid Glass redesign officially rolled out to most iOS WhatsApp users, the messaging platform is testing another visual change, this time focusing on the look of chat bubbles. Details below.

The new chat bubble looks rounder

Months ago, WhatsApp finally began rolling out the Liquid Glass redesign more broadly through TestFlight after several months of testing and refinement.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted clues in the app's code pointing to a redesign of WhatsApp's chat bubbles. The site now reports that the new bubble design is starting to be pushed to some users running the latest TestFlight version.

Here's what WABetaInfo had to say:

In addition to reshaping message bubbles, the new design also changes how media and links are displayed in conversations. WhatsApp has removed the green frames around them, making photos, videos, GIFs, and link previews look cleaner and more cohesive.

WABetaInfo notes that the new look is now available to some users running the WhatsApp TestFlight version. It is not yet clear when it will be rolled out more broadly to all iOS users.
